verdict.rationale: Factory's session API lets you create and manage Droid sessions—including lifecycle, settings, and messages—implying some ability to track a running agent's state, and the App/CLI let you review diffs as work progresses. However, there is no explicit documentation of a live status dashboard, streaming logs, or real-time progress view of an in-flight agent. Missing for 10: dedicated real-time monitoring UI/stream, explicit 'live status' feature documentation, independent confirmation of live tracking.
